title: MVP V3 Sprint 2: Epoch Snapshot schema versioning and replay gate
mvp_checklist: docs/CONCEPT_ROADMAP.md MVP V3 tasks: State schema versioning, replay determinism CI
brief: Implement MVP V3 foundation slice for current runtime Epoch Snapshot: make manifest schema versioning explicit, add a migration/compatibility contract for the existing manifest version, and add a lightweight replay determinism gate suitable for local/CI use. Do not implement future Bootstrap Snapshot, cleanup-chain, pruning, or external anchoring runtime semantics in this slice.

slices.title: Map snapshot/genesis/replay entry points
acceptance: pwm-info produces a reusable file map and implementation notes for coding/testing/review.
The map explicitly separates Epoch Snapshot manifest schema from genesis schema and future Bootstrap Snapshot semantics.

slices.title: Explicit Epoch Snapshot manifest schema contract
acceptance: Current manifest schema version is named/centralized rather than ad-hoc literal checks.
Unsupported manifest schema versions fail with an explicit error.
The implementation does not change current on-disk schema v1 behavior.

slices.title: Migration/compatibility table and tests
acceptance: There is a small migration/compatibility entry point for manifest schema v1.
Tests cover current schema v1 acceptance and unsupported version rejection.
No future Bootstrap Snapshot/pruning semantics are introduced.

slices.title: Replay determinism local/CI gate
acceptance: A reproducible command or focused test exists for V3 replay determinism.
Docs name the command and describe what it catches.
The gate is lightweight enough for focused CI/local use.

slices.title: Independent review of Sprint V3-2
acceptance: Any mechanical PASS_WITH_NITS items are auto-closed by the orchestrator conveyor.
